opinions.text:
D. Brooks Smith, Chief Judge
A majority of the active judges having voted for rehearing en banc in the above captioned cases, it is ordered that the petition for rehearing is GRANTED. The Clerk of this Court shall list the case for rehearing en banc on February 20, 2019. The opinion and judgment entered July 11, 2018 are hereby vacated.
